add_definitions(-D__WINESRC__ -D__ROS_LONG64__)

if(DLL_EXPORT_VERSION GREATER_EQUAL 0x600)
    spec2def(uxtheme.dll uxtheme_vista.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)
else()
    spec2def(uxtheme.dll uxtheme.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)
endif()

if(DLL_EXPORT_VERSION GREATER_EQUAL 0x600)
    add_definitions(-DENABLE_PNG_SUPPORT)

endif()

# uxtheme.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/uxtheme-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(uxtheme_shims OBJECT buffer.c draw.c errinfo.c main.c metric.c msstyles.c ncscrollbar.c nonclient.c property.c stylemap.c system.c themehooks.c uxini.c)
target_link_libraries(uxtheme_shims PRIVATE wine libuser32 libadvapi32 libgdiplus libgdi32 libshlwapi libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_cargo_module(uxtheme uxtheme-cargo uxtheme.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS uxtheme_shims psdk)
